example.title: Creased
lines: Every roof was once a page. Some still remember the words.
When the wind comes, the whole town rustles.
Do not get it wet.

world.title: Phantom
lines: A world where shadows stretch as far as the eye can see.
The river whispers secrets to the trees.
Though you stand here, you are everywhere.

world.title: Echoes
lines: Every night, the world whispers to the stars.
The darkness in a place becomes the light of hope.
Guarding the door of infinity.

world.title: Ephemeral
lines: A dawn is a fresh start, a chance to to.
To take small steps and be absorbed by the day.

world.title: Whispers
lines: In the heart of this land, the whispers of the wind can be heard.
As the sun sets, the golden rays reflect on the tranquil sand.
Do not let the beauty of nature pass you by.

world.title: Domain
lines: In the silence, knowledge blooms.
The soul's journey is a journey of understanding.
Guard your light, for it is the only thing that can guide.

world.title: Silent
lines: The silence is the best company, indeed.
Echoes the first sound, a whisper in the darkness.
Do not turn your back to the void.

world.title: Flickering
lines: A world of rhythm, where every shadow is a dance.
The forest dances with rain, a symphony of sounds.
The windmill sings a melody of the day.

world.title: Abyss
lines: In the heart of darkness, light shines for the strength of hope.
The silence is the voice of eternity, the one thing that matters.
Guarding the abyss is the guardian, a silence that never sleeps.
Lestinations, a passageway through the very heart of fear.
The very edge, where the shadows gather, where the brave dare to stand.

world.title: Daydream City
lines: The endless day was filled with endless possibilities.
Good days are few, so I try to take advantage of every moment.
Let it shine, let it rain, let the whole world know it was me.

world.title: Dusk
lines: Dusk is a soft whisper of the day's end.
The forest whispers secrets in the fog.
Every leaf holds the story of tomorrow.

world.title: Echoed
lines: In the heart of the darkness, the soul speaks to the soul.
Every breath is a whisper in the void.
The weight of the world is held on a thread.

world.title: Garden
lines: The garden holds a quiet promise.
Every petal whispers secrets.
The morning sun remarks.
Soft breezes caress the earth.

world.title: Eternity
lines: I am not a creator, but but I am a keeper.
In every hand of time, I stand, silent and still.
The stone whispers of eternity.

world.title: Silent Woods
lines: The dew is cool and fresh.
The willows shimmer in the mist.
Forest floors lie silent, waiting.
The trees stand tall and proud,
Unseen whispers flow through the leaves.
Leaves rustle softly in the breeze.

lines: The ice swirls like a living heart.
The sun casts a fiery glow.

world.title: Echoes
lines: The silence was the only sound that echoed through the caverns.
The moonlight cast long shadows that danced with the cold.
In the darkness, the echoes carried the weight of time.

world.title: Dormant
lines: The wind whispers secrets in the night.
With the sun far behind me, I fade to sleep.
I dream of heights and depths in the world below.

world.title: Endless View
lines: Every step is a new path.
The sun sets to the west.
Morning whispers secrets.

May your paths be as clear as the stars.

lines: The streets undulate like a sea of bones.
News has come from the shores.
The pigeons are the eyes of the city.
